title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page box: wide boxes (at least 1.8:1) lay the trace out horizontally with the stats beside it, other boxes stack the stats over a vertical trace. vertical: the ruler runs left to right like the playfield and older movement rises away from it. horizontal: newest movement at the right, playfield 0 at the top.

title: Alignment
description: Side the layout leans to. right suits the bottom-right corner (dash lane on the outer edge of a vertical trace, stats right of a horizontal one); left mirrors it for the left side.

title: Window / seconds
description: How much gameplay time the trace shows, newest at the ruler. Clamped to 2–30 s.

title: Show stats
description: Dash share of active play time (breaks excluded), distance travelled in screens (one screen = the 512 px playfield width) and direction changes per minute.

title: Hold on results
description: Keep the final stats on the results screen, along the bottom of the box; osu! does not show movement stats there.

title: Backing
description: none: marks float on the game with a text shadow. scrim: a soft dark fade behind the box. panel: a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of the dash marks and live markers. map: a tone taken from the current map's background; falls back to amber when the map has none.
